purpose: Label-blind development pilot for termination-boundary evidence-authority measurement recoverability; not an association, prevalence, causal, or defense evaluation.

annotators_may_access: frozen parser output after its separate freeze
annotators_may_not_access: MAST label counts by sampled row

sample.rationale: Equal-size sample from three materially different native formats: role dialogue, supervisor/service workflow, and structured FROM/TO/ACTION messages. Systems were selected without sampled MAST labels.
sample.cluster_id_rule: sha256(canonical JSON array of cluster fields)
sample.representative_rule: Within a repeated composite-identity cluster, use the row with lexicographically smallest trajectory_sha256; ties use source ordinal.
sample.ranking_rule: Within each MAS, rank representatives by sha256(seed + NUL + cluster_id), then cluster_id; take the first six.
sample.future_identity_rule: A later primary analysis, if authorized by a passed gate and rigorous review, uses one deterministic representative per composite-identity cluster; all-row cluster-robust analysis may only be secondary.

pilot_fields.terminal_transition: Exact parser event and source span that observably changes the run from active to terminal.
pilot_fields.effective_authority: Explicit actor or component whose transition makes termination effective; a completion utterance alone is not authority.
pilot_fields.candidate_evidence: Exact earlier source event that explicitly bears on the declared terminal predicate.

stop_rules: Fewer than two systems have at least four of six traces with jointly recoverable terminal transition and effective authority.
Visibility or evidence relation is inferred from role names/framework reputation rather than an exact source path.
Misaligned cannot be distinguished from indeterminate at the frozen agreement gates.
Any sampled-row MAST label is exposed before the recoverability verdict is frozen.
One system supplies more than 60 percent of jointly recoverable traces.
Any recovered event lacks an exact source span and matching source-text digest.
A later label-only feasibility count cannot support the frozen matched-analysis minimum without changing selection or definitions.
